_comment: EXPERIMENTAL. Procedural table for Logs -- per procedural_generation_scope_proposal.md #2 this was flagged 'poor fit' (bodyText IS the entry, ~80-90% prose), but the task asked to try it anyway. lib/proceduralGenerators.js slot-fills {name}/{location}/{item}/{faction} from this world's OWN live roster (lib/roster.js) wherever one exists, falling back to the generic pools below only when a world genuinely has nothing yet to reference (e.g. Logs generated before any NPCs/Locations/Items exist) -- this is the one category where grounding in real archived content, not just table variety, is the whole point. Every row in bodyTextTemplates/contextTemplates/fallbackNames/fallbackLocations/fallbackItems/titleTemplates now carries a `genre` field (array of post_apoc/fantasy/scifi/modern/horror, or "universal") -- see lib/proceduralGenerators.js's 'Genre awareness' section. logType itself (Audio/Journal/Terminal) stays a fixed 3-value enum across every genre -- genre only changes what those labels FLAVOR as physically (a fantasy 'Terminal' is a self-writing tome, not a command line); logTypes/designNotes are NOT genre-filtered and carry no genre field.

Audio.value:
[RECORDING BEGINS -- QUALITY DEGRADED]

...still there? Okay. Okay, if anyone finds this -- {name} said {item} would still be at {location}, and they were wrong, or somebody beat us to it. Either way I'm not going back for a second look.

[LONG PAUSE]

If this is {faction} picking this up -- I want it on record I didn't take anything that wasn't already abandoned.

[RECORDING ENDS]

[AUDIO LOG -- PERSONAL]

Day whatever. Lost count again. {name} still hasn't come back from {location}, and I keep telling myself that doesn't mean what it probably means.

[SOUND OF SOMETHING SHIFTING]

Going to go looking in the morning. If someone finds this instead of me -- tell {name} I kept the {item} safe, like I said I would.

[RECORDING ENDS]

[AUDIO LOG -- FIELD REPORT]

This is {name}, reporting in from {location}. {faction} activity is heavier here than the last briefing suggested -- recommend nobody comes through alone.

[STATIC]

Also recovered a {item} on site. Flagging it for anyone who actually knows what to do with it, because I sure don't.

[RECORDING ENDS]

[RECORDING -- SOURCE UNKNOWN]

...if you're hearing this, {location} isn't safe anymore. {name} tried to warn people and nobody listened, so I'm trying again.

[PAUSE]

Whatever you do, don't go looking for the {item}. It's not worth whatever's guarding it now.

[RECORDING ENDS]

[AUDIO LOG]

Funny thing about {location} -- everyone talks about it like it's cursed, but {name} lived there for years before things went bad. Found their {item} still sitting exactly where they left it.

[LONG SILENCE]

Makes you wonder what actually chased them out.

[RECORDING ENDS]

[AUDIO LOG -- {faction} INTERNAL]

This is for {faction} eyes only. {name} confirmed the situation at {location} is worse than reported -- recommend reassigning anyone stationed there before the next supply run.

[PAUSE]

The {item} recovered from the site is being held pending review. That's all for now.

[RECORDING ENDS]

[THE MEMORY CRYSTAL CATCHES LIGHT AND BEGINS TO SPEAK]

...if this crystal ever finds its way to anyone, know that {name} carried it last, near {location}. Whatever became of them, the {item} they were guarding should still be nearby -- I pray it's guarded better than they were.

[THE VOICE FADES, THEN STEADIES]

If {faction} recovers this, honor what {name} died protecting.

[THE CRYSTAL DIMS]

[VOICE BOUND WITHIN THE SCRYING STONE]

Speak my words true, stone, to whoever finds you next. {name} left for {location} three days past and has not returned. I fear the worst, though I dare not say it aloud even now.

[THE STONE FLICKERS]

Keep the {item} safe. It was theirs before it was ever mine.

[THE VISION FADES]

[THE ENCHANTED MIRROR HOLDS A RECORDED LIKENESS]

This is {name}, speaking for the record before the ritual at {location}. Should this working go wrong, let it be known the {item} was recovered honestly, and not stolen from {faction} as some have claimed.

[THE REFLECTION WAVERS]

May whoever scries this next judge more kindly than my rivals have.

[THE MIRROR STILLS]

[A VOICE BOUND INTO THE CRYSTAL, WORN NEARLY SMOOTH]

...{location} is not what the old maps claim. {name} warned me before I left, and I should have listened. If you're hearing this, do not seek the {item} that's said to rest there -- it is not worth what it costs to find.

[THE LIGHT GUTTERS]

Let this crystal be my only warning.

[SCRYING RECORD -- {faction} ARCHIVE]

For {faction}'s record only. {name} confirms the wards at {location} still hold, though weaker than the last reading.

[THE STONE PULSES ONCE]

The {item} recovered from the site has been sealed pending the Conclave's judgment. That is all this stone was asked to carry.

[THE VISION CLOSES]

[BLACK BOX RECOVERY -- AUDIO CHANNEL 3]

...{name} to anyone receiving, we are diverting to {location}, repeat, diverting to {location}. The {item} readings are inconsistent with the pre-flight briefing.

[SIGNAL DEGRADATION]

If {faction} picks this up, our last confirmed heading is on record. That's all we've got.

[TRANSMISSION LOST]

[COMM LOG -- PERSONAL CHANNEL]

This is {name}. Logging privately because the official channel's compromised, or I think it is.

{location} is not reading the way command briefed it. Recovered a {item} from the wreck. Not filing it through normal channels until I know who's actually listening.

[LOG ENDS]

[NEURAL RECORDING -- UNVERIFIED SOURCE]

...replaying this is going to feel wrong, whoever you are. It's {name}'s last logged thought before the interface failed at {location}.

[SIGNAL ARTIFACTS]

The {item} they were carrying is still logged as active. {faction} should know before anyone goes back for it.

[RECORDING CORRUPTED PAST THIS POINT]

[COMM LOG -- {faction} PRIORITY CHANNEL]

Flagged priority. {name} confirms conditions at {location} have deteriorated beyond the last assessment.

[STATIC BURST]

The {item} recovered on-site is being held for analysis pending {faction} clearance. Ending transmission here.

[LOG ENDS]

[VOICEMAIL -- 1 NEW MESSAGE]

Hey, it's {name}. Look, I know it's late, but I'm heading out to {location} and I wanted someone to know in case -- never mind, it's fine. Just, if you don't hear from me, the {item} is in the usual spot.

[MESSAGE ENDS]

[VOICEMAIL TRANSCRIPT -- RECOVERED]

It's me again. {name} still hasn't called back from {location} and I'm trying not to think about what that means.

[PAUSE]

If you get this before I do, tell them I kept the {item} like I said I would.

[MESSAGE ENDS]

[PODCAST RECORDING -- UNAIRED SEGMENT]

So we're standing here at {location}, and my producer {name} just found something you're not going to believe -- it looks like a {item}, just sitting out here like nobody wanted it.

[AUDIO CUTS OUT]

If anyone from {faction} is listening, we'd love a comment for the record.

[RECORDING ENDS ABRUPTLY]

[PHONE RECORDING -- FOUND ON DEVICE]

This is {name}, for the record, in case anyone from {faction} asks later. We're at {location} and everything checks out so far.

[BACKGROUND NOISE]

Oh -- also found a {item} here. Not sure who it belongs to. Flagging it just in case.

[RECORDING ENDS]

[ANSWERING MACHINE TAPE -- PLAYBACK]

"You've reached... you've reached {name}, leave a -- "

[THE MESSAGE CUTS TO SOMETHING ELSE]

"...they're still at {location}. Don't go looking for the {item}. Please. Don't --"

[TAPE ENDS]

[EVP SESSION -- RECORDED IN {location}]

[SILENCE, THEN A VOICE THAT ISN'T QUITE {name}'s]

"...cold..."

[LONG SILENCE]

"...the {item}... it's still... here..."

[NOTHING FURTHER RECORDED, THOUGH THE TAPE CONTINUES FOR SEVERAL MORE MINUTES]

[LAST WORDS -- RECOVERED FROM SCENE]

This is {name}. If anyone finds this, {faction} needs to know what's really at {location}.

[BREATHING, UNEVEN]

Don't send anyone else. Don't touch the {item}. I mean it. Don't --

[RECORDING ENDS]

[ANSWERING MACHINE -- MESSAGE 1 OF 1]

"Hi, it's {name}, sorry to call so late, I just -- I need someone to come get me from {location}, something's wrong, something's really --"

[THE LINE GOES DEAD]

[NO FURTHER MESSAGES ON THIS DEVICE]

[EVP -- {faction} INVESTIGATION FILE]

[BACKGROUND HUM]

"...{name}..."

[A SECOND, FAINTER VOICE, POSSIBLY OVERLAPPING]

"...bring back the {item}... bring it back..."

[RECORDING TERMINATES ITSELF -- DEVICE MALFUNCTION UNEXPLAINED]

Journal.value:
Still can't sleep. Keep thinking about what {name} said before they left for {location} -- that it wasn't as bad as everyone made it sound. I hope they were right.

Found the {item} in their things today. Not sure what to do with it yet. Feels wrong to use it. Feels worse to just leave it.

Third entry this week, which is more than I usually manage. {location} is finally starting to feel less like a temporary stop and more like somewhere we're actually staying.

{name} thinks I'm being naive about it. Maybe. Traded half our {item} stock today for something we actually needed, so at least that went well.

Today {name} asked me straight out whether I trusted {faction}. Took me longer to answer than it should have.

Spent the rest of the day going through what's left at {location}, trying to figure out what's worth carrying and what isn't. Kept the {item}. Couldn't tell you exactly why.

Woke up before everyone else again. Walked out to {location} alone, which {name} would absolutely lecture me about if they knew.

Found a {item} half-buried near where the old road used to be. Didn't touch it. Some things you leave exactly where they are.

{name} left today. Didn't say much, just took the {item} and headed for {location} without waiting to see if anyone wanted to come.

I keep telling myself they'll be back. I've told myself that before about other people.

Good day, for once. {faction} came through on what they promised, and {location} is finally starting to feel secure enough to actually plan around.

{name} even cracked a joke for the first time in longer than I can remember. Small things.

Prayed twice today, once for {name}'s safe return from {location}, once for my own courage to follow if they don't come back by week's end. Found the {item} among their things while I waited. I do not know if keeping it is faith or foolishness.

Third page I've filled this moon, more than I've managed in a season. {location} is beginning to feel less like a waystation and more like somewhere we might actually winter.

{name} thinks I trust it too easily. Perhaps. Traded away half our stock of {item} today for grain, and slept easier for it.

{name} asked me plainly today whether {faction} could be trusted with what we found. I did not have a ready answer, which troubled me more than the question itself.

Spent the evening sorting what remains at {location}, deciding what's worth the weight of carrying. Kept the {item}. I could not tell you why.

Rose before the sun again, as I have too often lately. Walked out toward {location} alone, which {name} would scold me for soundly if they knew.

Found a {item} half-sunk in the old riverbed there. Left it exactly where it lay. Some things are not meant to be carried home.

{name} departed at first light, taking only the {item} and a promise to send word from {location}. They did not wait to see who might follow.

I have told myself before that they would return. I have been wrong about that before, too.

Datapad entry, personal partition. Can't stop thinking about what {name} said before shipping out to {location} -- that it wasn't as bad as the briefing made it sound. Hope they were right.

Found the {item} in their bunk today. Haven't decided what to do with it yet.

Crew log, third entry this cycle -- more than I usually manage. {location} is starting to feel less like a temporary posting and more like somewhere we might actually be stationed long-term.

{name} thinks I'm being naive about it. Maybe. Traded half our {item} reserve today for parts we actually needed.

{name} asked me directly today whether I trust {faction}'s command structure. Took longer to answer than it should have.

Spent the rest of the shift cataloguing what's salvageable at {location}. Kept the {item}. Couldn't tell you exactly why.

Personal log. {name} transferred out today, no real explanation, just took the {item} and requested reassignment to {location} before anyone could talk them out of it.

Keep telling myself they'll rotate back eventually. I've told myself that before, about other people.

Can't sleep. Keep replaying what {name} said before heading to {location} -- that it wasn't as bad as everyone made it sound. Hope they were right.

Found the {item} in their desk drawer today. Not sure what to do with it. Feels wrong to touch it. Feels worse to leave it.

Planner note, Thursday: {location} finally starting to feel less temporary and more like somewhere we're actually staying.

{name} says I'm being naive about it. Maybe. Sold off half our {item} today for something we actually needed.

{name} asked me point blank today if I trust {faction}. Took longer to answer than it should have.

Spent the evening going through what's left at {location}, deciding what's worth keeping. Kept the {item}. Couldn't tell you why.

{name} left today. Didn't explain much, just grabbed the {item} and headed for {location} without waiting to see if anyone wanted to come along.

Keep telling myself they'll be back. I've told myself that before, about other people.
Went to {location} today with {name}. Nothing unusual, really. Just an odd feeling I can't shake, like something noticed us leaving.
{name} won't talk about what happened at {location} anymore. I found the {item} they brought back hidden in the back of a closet. I wish I hadn't looked at it as long as I did.
I keep dreaming about {location}, even though I've never actually been. {name} says that's normal, given everything. I don't think it's normal. I don't think {name} believes that either.
Something is wrong with the {item}. I know how that sounds. {name} doesn't see it, or won't say if they do. I've stopped keeping it in the house.

I don't remember writing yesterday's entry. The handwriting is mine but I don't remember any of it -- not {location}, not what happened to {name}, none of it. I'm going to stop writing in this book. I don't think that's really my decision to make anymore.

> SYSTEM RECOVERY -- PARTIAL LOG RECONSTRUCTED

> {name}: requesting status update on {location} perimeter.
> SYSTEM: no response received from field unit in 6+ cycles.
> {name}: escalating to {faction}. attaching last known asset report: {item}, last logged as secure.

> [REMAINDER OF LOG CORRUPTED]

> USER {name} LOGGED IN
> NOTE: found {item} while clearing debris at {location}. logging for records, unclear if still functional.
> NOTE: {faction} contact says they want it examined before anyone else touches it.
> USER {name} LOGGED OUT

> [NO FURTHER ACTIVITY ON THIS TERMINAL]

> {name}: anyone still monitoring this terminal?
> {name}: if so, {location} needs resupply before the week's out.
> {name}: also logging the {item} we found here, in case it matters to {faction} later.

> [NO REPLY LOGGED]

~ THE LEDGER WRITES OF ITS OWN ACCORD ~

Entry, in the hand of {name}: a discrepancy noted regarding the {item}, to be brought before {faction} for judgment.

Entry, unfinished: the matter was --

~ THE INK STOPS MID-WORD, THE PAGE STILL DAMP ~

~ THE ORACLE'S SLATE STIRS AND BEGINS TO WRITE ~

{name} inquires as to the wards surrounding {location}.

The slate answers: no answer has come from that quarter in six turnings of the moon.

{name} resolves to inform {faction}, attaching the {item} as evidence the site was, at least once, secure.

~ THE SLATE FALLS SILENT, ITS SURFACE STILL WET WITH INK ~

~ AUTOMATIC WRITING, RECORDED BY THE BOUND TOME ~

{name} writes: found the {item} while clearing the ruin at {location}. Uncertain whether it still holds power.

{name} writes further: a contact within {faction} wishes it examined before any other hand touches it.

~ THE TOME CLOSES ITSELF, AS IT ALWAYS DOES WHEN THE ENTRY IS DONE ~

~ THE LEDGER'S STANDING REPORT, {location} ~

LAST TENDED BY: {name}

FLAGGED: one {item}, provenance unconfirmed

THE INK NOTES: {faction} has requested it be handled with priority. The request remains, as of this writing, unanswered.

~ THE PAGE HAS NOT TURNED SINCE ~

~ THE SLATE, WRITING AS THOUGH IN ANSWER TO A QUESTION NO ONE ASKED ~

{name} inquires whether anyone still consults this tome.

{name} continues: if so, {location} wants provisioning before the season turns.

{name} adds, almost as an afterthought: the {item} found here has been recorded, in case {faction} has use for it later.

~ NO FURTHER HAND HAS TOUCHED THE PAGE ~

> SYSTEM RECOVERY -- PARTIAL RECONSTRUCTION

> {name}: requesting status on {location} perimeter sensors.
> SYSTEM: no telemetry received from field unit in 6+ cycles.
> {name}: escalating to {faction}. attaching last known asset status: {item}, logged secure at time of last contact.

> [REMAINDER OF LOG UNREADABLE]

> USER {name} AUTHENTICATED
> NOTE: recovered {item} during debris clearance at {location}. functionality unconfirmed, flagging for review.
> NOTE: {faction} liaison requesting examination priority before further handling.
> USER {name} SESSION CLOSED

> [NO FURTHER ACTIVITY LOGGED ON THIS TERMINAL]

[NOTES APP -- LAST EDITED]

- follow up w/ {name} re: {location}
- {item} discrepancy?? flag for {faction} before Friday
- [note cuts off mid-sentence]

[FILE NOT SAVED -- AUTO-RECOVERED DRAFT]

[NOTES APP -- SHARED WITH: {faction}]

{name}: hey has anyone else been out to {location} this week
{name}: found a {item} out there, kind of weird tbh
{name}: lmk if this rings a bell for anyone

[NO REPLIES]

[VOICE-TO-TEXT DRAFT -- UNSENT]

Um, hey, it's {name}, just leaving myself a note about {location} before I forget. The {item} thing is still bugging me, gonna mention it to {faction} tomorrow if I remember.

[DRAFT NEVER SENT]

> USER {name} LOGGED IN AT 3:14 AM
> note: can't sleep. checked the {item} logs from {location} again. numbers don't match what I remember entering.
> note: going to ask {faction} if anyone else has noticed this.
> USER {name} LOGGED OUT

> [SYSTEM CLOCK READS 3:14 AM FOR ALL SUBSEQUENT ENTRIES]

> {name}: does anyone else's terminal do this
> {name}: the {item} entry keeps updating itself and I'm not touching the keyboard
> {name}: {faction} if you're seeing this please respond
> {name}: it's still doing it

> [NO REPLY LOGGED -- CURSOR STILL BLINKING]

> SESSION RESTORED FROM UNEXPECTED SHUTDOWN
> LAST USER: {name}
> LAST ACTION: searched "{location}" 214 times in one session
> LAST NOTE LEFT: "the {item} was never supposed to leave {location}"

> [NO FURTHER SESSIONS UNDER THIS USERNAME]

> {faction} INTERNAL -- FLAGGED FOR REVIEW
> {name}'s terminal has been logging activity during hours {name} was confirmed off-site.
> flagged item: {item}, {location} origin
> STATUS: unresolved

> [TERMINAL REMAINS ACTIVE. NO USER CURRENTLY LOGGED IN.]

designNotes.value: EXPERIMENTAL -- rolled procedurally from a Mad-Libs template, slot-filled with real roster names/locations/items where this world had any archived yet. This is the proposal's own flagged 'poor fit': bodyText IS the entry, and a templated found-text log reads noticeably more mechanical on a close read than an AI-drafted one, even with real names slotted in. Treat this as a placeholder worth a manual rewrite, not a finished log.
